content.rationale: D11 fixes help as the self-describing surface and omsvqqor the bare list; rwlywqrk and O5 fix how the lines read (plain UTF-8, newline-terminated). This renders only the bare list from the table it is handed — one verb name per line, in order — and returns the text; the envelope owns the channel. The table is generic over the injected context (M-context-injection); the list reads only names. Per-verb --help is each verb's own content.
